headline: Weathered Expanse Only Region With Strongpoint Changes in Latest Watch
war_summary: Since the earlier bulletin, front-line movement has narrowed. The Weathered Expanse was the only region to report strongpoint transfers in the latest two-hour watch, logging two such changes and five over the six-hour count; Frostmarch and Crow's Nest remain the busiest positions. Its twenty-four-hour total stands at thirty-five shifts. Casualty rates there topped three hundred per hour on each side in the most recent two-hour tally. Stlican Shelf and Fisherman's Row also recorded six events across the six-hour period but none in the final two hours, indicating their recent flurries have slackened. Godcrofts still carries the largest one-day ledger with forty changes, though it has produced no event in the last six hours. Stonecradle, after twelve daily changes and two in six hours, likewise went quiet in the latest two-hour stretch. Linn Mercy, with eight daily changes, remains quiet. Heavy casualty reports persist at Callahan's Passage, Farranac Coast, and Mooring County without fresh strongpoint transfers. The war continues undecided, with no side past the thirty-four victory towns required.
